```{r}
# ============================================================
# Mixed-effects analysis of age-group differences
# Separate models for audio and text
# Audio model includes voice as a fixed effect
#
# Outcomes:
#   V = valence
#   A = arousal
#
# Fixed effects:
#   Text model:  group
#   Audio model: group + voice
#
# Random effects:
#   participant
#   story
#   story:segment
#
# Effect size:
#   model-based standardized mean difference:
#   d = estimated marginal mean difference / residual SD
# ============================================================

# ----------------------------
# 1. Load packages
# ----------------------------

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(readr)
library(glue)

# Optional but recommended for Type-III tests
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# ----------------------------
# 2. Output directory
# ----------------------------

# If Dir_output already exists in your environment, this will use it.
# If not, it will save outputs to the current working directory.
Dir_output <- "X:/PROJECTS/ABC@UofSC/3-Experiments/NSF_valence/github/derivatives/behavioral/ACII"

dir.create(Dir_output, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ----------------------------
# 3. Prepare data
# ----------------------------

df <- df_ratings %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group),
    !is.na(subID),
    !is.na(narrative),
    !is.na(segID),
    modality %in% c("audio", "text")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("young", "middle", "old")),
    modality = factor(modality, levels = c("audio", "text")),
    subID = factor(subID),
    story = factor(narrative),
    segID = factor(segID),
    story_seg = interaction(story, segID, drop = TRUE, sep = "_")
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4. Extract voice from audio column
#    voice = prefix before the first "_"
# ----------------------------

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    voice = ifelse(
      modality == "audio" & !is.na(audio) & audio != "",
      sub("^([^_]+)_.*$", "\\1", as.character(audio)),
      NA
    ),
    voice = factor(voice)
  )

# Check voice extraction
cat("\n--- Voice counts ---\n")
print(table(df$voice, useNA = "ifany"))

# ----------------------------
# 5. Split data by modality
# ----------------------------

df_audio <- df %>%
  filter(modality == "audio", !is.na(voice))

df_text <- df %>%
  filter(modality == "text")

cat("\n--- Data counts ---\n")
cat("Audio rows:", nrow(df_audio), "\n")
cat("Text rows:", nrow(df_text), "\n")
cat("Audio participants:", n_distinct(df_audio$subID), "\n")
cat("Text participants:", n_distinct(df_text$subID), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 6. Helper function:
#    pairwise contrasts + model-based effect sizes
# ============================================================
get_pairwise_with_effect_size <- function(emm_obj, model, adjust_method = "fdr") {

  # ----------------------------
  # Small helper to safely find column names
  # ----------------------------
  pick_col <- function(df, candidates, required = TRUE) {
    hit <- intersect(candidates, names(df))

    if (length(hit) > 0) {
      return(hit[1])
    }

    if (required) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "None of these columns were found: ",
          paste(candidates, collapse = ", "),
          "\nAvailable columns are: ",
          paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
        )
      )
    }

    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 1. Pairwise estimated marginal mean contrasts
  # ============================================================

  pw <- pairs(emm_obj)

  # p-values, adjusted using requested method
  pw_test <- as.data.frame(
    summary(pw, adjust = adjust_method)
  )

  # unadjusted 95% CIs for the estimated mean differences
  # Note: FDR adjusts p-values, not confidence intervals.
  pw_ci <- as.data.frame(
    confint(pw, adjust = "none")
  )

  est_col   <- pick_col(pw_test, c("estimate"))
  se_col    <- pick_col(pw_test, c("SE"))
  df_col    <- pick_col(pw_test, c("df"), required = FALSE)
  stat_col  <- pick_col(pw_test, c("t.ratio", "z.ratio"))
  p_col     <- pick_col(pw_test, c("p.value"))

  lower_col <- pick_col(
    pw_ci,
    c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL", "lower.HPD", "LCL", "lower")
  )

  upper_col <- pick_col(
    pw_ci,
    c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL", "upper.HPD", "UCL", "upper")
  )

  pw_df <- data.frame(
    contrast = pw_test$contrast,
    mean_diff = pw_test[[est_col]],
    diff_SE = pw_test[[se_col]],
    diff_df = if (!is.na(df_col)) pw_test[[df_col]] else NA_real_,
    statistic = pw_test[[stat_col]],
    statistic_type = ifelse(stat_col == "z.ratio", "z", "t"),
    p_adjusted = pw_test[[p_col]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  pw_ci_df <- data.frame(
    contrast = pw_ci$contrast,
    diff_lower_CL = pw_ci[[lower_col]],
    diff_upper_CL = pw_ci[[upper_col]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  pw_df <- pw_df %>%
    left_join(pw_ci_df, by = "contrast") %>%
    select(
      contrast,
      mean_diff,
      diff_SE,
      diff_df,
      diff_lower_CL,
      diff_upper_CL,
      statistic,
      statistic_type,
      p_adjusted
    )

  # ============================================================
  # 2. Model-based standardized mean differences
  #    d = EMM difference / residual SD
  # ============================================================

  eff <- eff_size(
    emm_obj,
    sigma = sigma(model),
    edf = df.residual(model),
    method = "pairwise"
  )

  eff_test <- as.data.frame(
    summary(eff)
  )

  eff_ci <- as.data.frame(
    confint(eff, adjust = "none")
  )

  eff_est_col <- pick_col(eff_test, c("effect.size", "estimate"))
  eff_se_col  <- pick_col(eff_test, c("SE"))
  eff_df_col  <- pick_col(eff_test, c("df"), required = FALSE)

  eff_lower_col <- pick_col(
    eff_ci,
    c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL", "lower.HPD", "LCL", "lower")
  )

  eff_upper_col <- pick_col(
    eff_ci,
    c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL", "upper.HPD", "UCL", "upper")
  )

  eff_df <- data.frame(
    contrast = eff_test$contrast,
    std_mean_diff = eff_test[[eff_est_col]],
    d_SE = eff_test[[eff_se_col]],
    d_df = if (!is.na(eff_df_col)) eff_test[[eff_df_col]] else NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  eff_ci_df <- data.frame(
    contrast = eff_ci$contrast,
    d_lower_CL = eff_ci[[eff_lower_col]],
    d_upper_CL = eff_ci[[eff_upper_col]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  eff_df <- eff_df %>%
    left_join(eff_ci_df, by = "contrast") %>%
    select(
      contrast,
      std_mean_diff,
      d_SE,
      d_df,
      d_lower_CL,
      d_upper_CL
    )

  # ============================================================
  # 3. Combine pairwise results and effect sizes
  # ============================================================

  out <- pw_df %>%
    left_join(eff_df, by = "contrast")

  return(out)
}
# ============================================================
# 7. Helper function:
#    format likelihood-ratio test output
# ============================================================

format_lrt <- function(model_null, model_full) {
  lrt <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  lrt_df <- data.frame(
    model = rownames(lrt),
    lrt,
    row.names = NULL
  )
  return(lrt_df)
}

# ============================================================
# 8. Text model function
# ============================================================

run_text_mixed_analysis <- function(data, outcome) {

  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("TEXT MODEL | Outcome:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")

  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]))

  # ----------------------------
  # Descriptives
  # ----------------------------

  desc <- data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_ratings = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(subID),
      n_stories = n_distinct(story),
      n_story_segments = n_distinct(story_seg),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  cat("\n--- Descriptives ---\n")
  print(desc)

  # ----------------------------
  # Full model
  # ----------------------------

  form_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ group + ",
      "(1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)"
    )
  )

  model_full <- lmer(
    form_full,
    data = data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

  cat("\n--- Full model summary ---\n")
  print(summary(model_full))

  cat("\n--- Type-III Wald test ---\n")
  type3 <- car::Anova(model_full, type = 3)
  print(type3)

  cat("\n--- Singularity check ---\n")
  print(isSingular(model_full, tol = 1e-4))

  # ----------------------------
  # Omnibus likelihood-ratio test for group
  # ----------------------------

  form_null <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ 1 + ",
      "(1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)"
    )
  )

  model_null <- lmer(
    form_null,
    data = data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

  cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test for group effect ---\n")
  lrt_group <- format_lrt(model_null, model_full)
  print(lrt_group)

  # ----------------------------
  # Estimated marginal means
  # ----------------------------

  emm_group <- emmeans(model_full, ~ group)

  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means for group ---\n")
  print(summary(emm_group, infer = TRUE))

  # ----------------------------
  # Pairwise group comparisons with effect sizes
  # ----------------------------

  cat("\n--- Pairwise group comparisons with effect sizes ---\n")
  pairwise_group <- get_pairwise_with_effect_size(
    emm_obj = emm_group,
    model = model_full,
    adjust_method = "fdr"
  )
  print(pairwise_group)

  return(list(
    desc = desc,
    model_full = model_full,
    model_null = model_null,
    type3 = type3,
    lrt_group = lrt_group,
    emm_group = as.data.frame(summary(emm_group, infer = TRUE)),
    pairwise_group = pairwise_group
  ))
}

# ============================================================
# 9. Audio model function
# ============================================================

run_audio_mixed_analysis <- function(data, outcome) {

  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("AUDIO MODEL | Outcome:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")

  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]), !is.na(voice))

  # ----------------------------
  # Descriptives
  # ----------------------------

  desc_group <- data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_ratings = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(subID),
      n_stories = n_distinct(story),
      n_story_segments = n_distinct(story_seg),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  desc_group_voice <- data %>%
    group_by(group, voice) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_ratings = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(subID),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  cat("\n--- Descriptives by group ---\n")
  print(desc_group)

  cat("\n--- Descriptives by group and voice ---\n")
  print(desc_group_voice)

  # ----------------------------
  # Full model
  # ----------------------------

  form_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ group + voice + ",
      "(1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)"
    )
  )

  model_full <- lmer(
    form_full,
    data = data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

  cat("\n--- Full model summary ---\n")
  print(summary(model_full))

  cat("\n--- Type-III Wald test ---\n")
  type3 <- car::Anova(model_full, type = 3)
  print(type3)

  cat("\n--- Singularity check ---\n")
  print(isSingular(model_full, tol = 1e-4))

  # ----------------------------
  # Omnibus likelihood-ratio test for group
  # Keep voice in the null model
  # ----------------------------

  form_null_group <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ voice + ",
      "(1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)"
    )
  )

  model_null_group <- lmer(
    form_null_group,
    data = data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

  cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test for group effect ---\n")
  lrt_group <- format_lrt(model_null_group, model_full)
  print(lrt_group)

  # ----------------------------
  # Omnibus likelihood-ratio test for voice
  # Keep group in the null model
  # ----------------------------

  form_null_voice <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ group + ",
      "(1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)"
    )
  )

  model_null_voice <- lmer(
    form_null_voice,
    data = data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

  cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test for voice effect ---\n")
  lrt_voice <- format_lrt(model_null_voice, model_full)
  print(lrt_voice)

  # ----------------------------
  # Estimated marginal means for group
  # These are adjusted for voice.
  # ----------------------------

  emm_group <- emmeans(model_full, ~ group)

  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means for group, adjusted for voice ---\n")
  print(summary(emm_group, infer = TRUE))

  cat("\n--- Pairwise group comparisons with effect sizes ---\n")
  pairwise_group <- get_pairwise_with_effect_size(
    emm_obj = emm_group,
    model = model_full,
    adjust_method = "fdr"
  )
  print(pairwise_group)

  # ----------------------------
  # Estimated marginal means for voice
  # These are adjusted for group.
  # ----------------------------

  emm_voice <- emmeans(model_full, ~ voice)

  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means for voice, adjusted for group ---\n")
  print(summary(emm_voice, infer = TRUE))

  cat("\n--- Pairwise voice comparisons with effect sizes ---\n")
  pairwise_voice <- get_pairwise_with_effect_size(
    emm_obj = emm_voice,
    model = model_full,
    adjust_method = "fdr"
  )
  print(pairwise_voice)

  return(list(
    desc_group = desc_group,
    desc_group_voice = desc_group_voice,
    model_full = model_full,
    model_null_group = model_null_group,
    model_null_voice = model_null_voice,
    type3 = type3,
    lrt_group = lrt_group,
    lrt_voice = lrt_voice,
    emm_group = as.data.frame(summary(emm_group, infer = TRUE)),
    pairwise_group = pairwise_group,
    emm_voice = as.data.frame(summary(emm_voice, infer = TRUE)),
    pairwise_voice = pairwise_voice
  ))
}

# ============================================================
# 10. Run analyses
# ============================================================

text_V_results <- run_text_mixed_analysis(df_text, "V")
text_A_results <- run_text_mixed_analysis(df_text, "A")

audio_V_results <- run_audio_mixed_analysis(df_audio, "V")
audio_A_results <- run_audio_mixed_analysis(df_audio, "A")

# ============================================================
# 11. Save pairwise comparisons with effect sizes
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  text_V_results$pairwise_group,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_text_valence_group_pairs_with_effect_size.csv")
)

write_csv(
  text_A_results$pairwise_group,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_text_arousal_group_pairs_with_effect_size.csv")
)

write_csv(
  audio_V_results$pairwise_group,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_valence_group_pairs_with_effect_size.csv")
)

write_csv(
  audio_A_results$pairwise_group,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_arousal_group_pairs_with_effect_size.csv")
)

write_csv(
  audio_V_results$pairwise_voice,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_valence_voice_pairs_with_effect_size.csv")
)

write_csv(
  audio_A_results$pairwise_voice,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_arousal_voice_pairs_with_effect_size.csv")
)
```
